user.title: New chore
user.description: The chore is first due one interval after the start date. Marking it done restarts the countdown from that day.

abort.already_configured: A chore with this name already exists.

init.title: Edit chore schedule
init.description: Changing the start date restarts the countdown from the new date. Changing the interval recalculates the next due date from the last completion. To move just the next due date, use the chore's "Next due date" entity.

mark_done.name: Mark done
mark_done.description: Marks a chore as done today and restarts its countdown.
